description: A modern, open-source IPTV live TV streaming web application with HLS playback, custom M3U playlist importing, and PWA capabilities.
features: Custom M3U and M3U8 URL and local file upload
Schema.org BroadcastEvent and VideoObject JSON-LD support
Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline shell and standalone display
Categorized rows: News, Sports, Movies, Cinema, Music, Kids, Documentaries
Keyboard shortcut Ctrl+K search and TV Guide drawer overlay
